name: Bar & Restaurant POS
description: Commercial-grade multi-hotel Web POS system for Royal Green Garden Hotel, Home Field Hotel and Nuwara Eliya Hotel. Each hotel has separate logins, users and business data, with Bar & Restaurant ordering, multi-size bottle variants, hotel room management & booking tickets, physical daily stock sheet register reconciliation, inventory, stock movement, KOT, hold bills, billing, invoicing, payments, reporting, audit logs, and role-based access control.
